name: Aluminium 4-Port USB Hub (USB-C or USB-A)
shortDescription: Slim aluminium 4-port hub, available with a USB-C or USB-A plug.
description: A stylish mini hub in a brushed-aluminium shell that adds extra USB ports to laptops and tablets. Choose the USB-C version for modern laptops or USB-A for older machines.

specifications.label: Ports
specifications.value: 4 × USB-A (1 × USB 3.0 + 3 × USB 2.0 typical — confirm with supplier)
